name: Industrial Next
description: 开发AI驱动的自包含机器人工作站，通过专有基础模型连接视觉、任务上下文和运动，让工厂产线能在几分钟内重新配置而非数周，无需传统编程即可自动化复杂精密任务
description_en: Develops AI-driven, self-contained robotic stations powered by proprietary foundation models that connect vision, task context and motion, enabling factory production lines to be retooled in minutes rather than weeks without traditional programming for complex and delicate task automation
why_matters: 使用高保真仿真引擎训练机器人执行高精度装配任务，已成功部署在全球最受欢迎智能手机之一的生产线上，完成制造商多年无法自动化的任务如穿线软性排线和扣接微小连接器帽，剥膜工作站达到或超过人类速度且100%准确率
why_matters_en: Uses extremely high-fidelity simulation engine to train robots for high-precision assembly tasks, already deployed in production of one of the world's most popular smartphones, handling tasks manufacturers failed to automate for years such as threading delicate flex cables and snapping tiny connector caps, with film peeling stations achieving at or above human speed with 100% accuracy
latest_news: 2026年10月13日在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Startup Battlefield舞台展示，宣布与宝马集团技术办公室(BMW Group Technology Office)合作评估其AI驱动的灵巧操作技术用于制造
latest_news_en: Presented on Startup Battlefield stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 on October 13, 2026, announced partnership with BMW Group Technology Office to evaluate AI-powered dexterous manipulation for manufacturing
source_title: Industrial Next wants factory robots to switch tasks in minutes, not weeks

evidence.quote: Industrial Next was founded in 2021 by Lukas Pankau and Allen Pan, both of whom previously worked at Tesla. Pankau served as a lead electrical architect at Tesla before moving on to Waymo. Pan led Tesla's autonomous factory efforts and later became a chief architect at autonomous driving company Neolix.

The secret sauce for the robots that we have is that we have given them an understanding of the process in general, but we build that understanding using an extremely high-fidelity simulation engine that is close to the real dynamics to where we can let the robot do these kinds of high precision tasks almost without seeing the parts at all.

some of the startup's workstations are already used in making one of the world's most popular smartphones. They handle tasks that manufacturers had tried and failed to automate for years, such as threading a delicate flex cable and snapping a tiny connector cap into place.

name: Sonilo
description: 一个生成式音频平台,利用多模态AI技术(Sound World Model)自动为视频内容创作匹配的音乐和音效。该系统能够理解视频画面的运动和情感变化,逐帧分析场景,生成与视频内容自然同步的商用音频。此外还提供AI配音和唇形同步功能,帮助短剧和内容工作室进行多语言本地化。
description_en: A generative audio platform that uses multimodal AI technology (Sound World Model) to automatically create music and sound effects that match video content. The system understands movement and emotional shifts in video footage, analyzes scenes frame by frame, and generates audio naturally synced for commercial use. Also offers AI dubbing with lip-sync for video localization.
why_matters: Sonilo区别于传统音频工具的核心在于其多模态视频理解能力:不是简单生成独立音轨,而是通过分析视频内容的节奏、情感和叙事自动匹配音频。创始团队来自TikTok的AI和音乐部门,拥有深厚技术和行业背景。在版权方面采用授权音乐训练模型,与Shutterstock等机构合作并与艺术家分成,为短视频创作者和企业提供合规的AI原生视频音频解决方案。
why_matters_en: Sonilo differentiates itself through multimodal video comprehension: rather than generating standalone audio, it analyzes video pacing, emotion, and narrative to automatically fit audio to scenes. The founding team comes from TikTok's AI and music divisions with deep technical and industry expertise. On rights, models are trained on licensed music, partnering with Shutterstock and revenue-sharing with artists, providing compliant AI-native video audio solutions for short-form creators and enterprises.
latest_news: 2026年10月获得B Capital领投、Redpoint参投的1100万美元融资,资金将用于扩展计算能力以扩大模型规模。已与TapNow和ComfyUI达成早期分发合作,消费者应用计划于2026年第四季度推出。
latest_news_en: Raised $11 million in October 2026 led by B Capital with Redpoint participating, funding will pay for computing power to scale models. Signed early distribution partnerships with TapNow and ComfyUI, consumer app set to launch in Q4 2026.
source_title: TikTok Veterans' AI Audio Startup Sonilo Raises $11 Million

website_verification.title: Sonilo: AI Music & Sound Effects for Your Videos Sonilo

evidence.quote: San Francisco-based Sonilo secured the round with B Capital leading and Redpoint also taking part.

Song, who trained at CMU, led multimodal AI technology work at TikTok, where he worked alongside Alex Yin, Sonilo's CTO. Yin earned a doctorate in computer music at the University of York. COO Keli Li built and ran TikTok's global music operation

Sonilo's core technology, which it calls the Sound World Model, is a multimodal system that ties video comprehension to audio generation and timing. It doesn't handle music and effects as standalone pieces. Instead, it reads a scene's movement and emotional shifts, then produces audio built for that particular footage.

why_matters: Loops将分散的电商AI工具整合为单一操作系统,A101超市的实际数据显示使用该平台的会话购买转化率提高约83%,64%的试点客户转化为付费客户,已服务超过70家客户并处理数百万次购物体验
why_matters_en: Loops unifies fragmented ecommerce AI tools into a single operating system, with A101 showing roughly 83% higher purchase conversion in sessions using the platform, 64% pilot-to-paying customer conversion rate, serving over 70 customers with millions of shopper experiences

source_title: Loops Closes $3.5M in Funding to Build the AI Operating System for Commerce

website_verification.title: Loops | Email Platform for SaaS: Marketing & Transactional Loops

evidence.quote: The company has announced a $3.5 million seed round from a16z speedrun, NTT Docomo, Connecticut Innovations, Alumni Ventures and Monday Capital.

The journey Loops started with a failed purchase. Co-founders Ari Nazir and İlker Selim Zorluoğlu were in Bali when İlker tried to buy a gift for his two-year-old daughter, messaged the retailer, and waited hours for a reply. He never bought it. The founders dug into why and found a bigger gap than slow support: shoppers were already telling AI what they wanted in plain language, while most of ecommerce still ran on keyword search, filters and separate support queues. In a mere weekend, Nazir built the first prototype of what has now become a company that has over 70 customers and pilots, and has handled millions of shopper experiences, with sixty-four percent of pilots converting into paying customers.

Rather than offering separate AI tools, the platform unifies AI search, a shopping assistant, product enrichment and virtual try-on into one system that follows shoppers from discovery to purchase, with retailers such as A101 and Mavi among its users and A101 sessions showing roughly 83% higher observed purchase conversion.
